writesPerformedNote: This tranche and the measurements it records performed no PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Valkey or Neo4j writes. Ollama embedding requests were read-only measurements.

cohort.definition: atlas_packet_chunk_lineage rows joined to codebase_chunk_index by chunk_row_id where content_embedding IS NOT NULL

recipe.identificationRule: exactly one tested recipe reproduced the stored vector at cosine >= 0.995; top-1 to top-2 cosine margin >= 0.018 on every row
recipe.recoveredNote: 477 rows carry no recipe claim (448 plain embeddinggemma:latest, 29 with a hash-valued embedding_version); their recipe is recovered by measurement only.

reproducibility.toleranceNote: The 1-ulp per-element bound is derived from binary16 semantics. It replaces an earlier absolute 6.1e-5 bound that had been chosen after seeing the observed maximum and is not used.
reproducibility.digestExactReason: Current-runtime output can vary by approximately one FP16 ULP with request and batch composition. Two rows that were not digest-exact in one pass were 0 ulp in a later pass. digestExactObserved is a single-pass observation and must not be treated as a frozen property of the population; FP16 equivalence within one ulp is the stable invariant.
reproducibility.measurementPasses: Classification is composed from two measurement passes over the same cohort: a full pass (6,453 digest-exact, 321 not) and a second pass re-embedding only the 321 non-digest rows, all of which were within one ulp (319 at maximum one ulp, 2 at zero). The 6,453 were not re-measured in the second pass.

representationEvidenceGradeSemantics.HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT_EXACT: historical execution is bound to an immutable model artifact digest
representationEvidenceGradeSemantics.CURRENT_RUNTIME_REPRODUCIBLE: current runtime reproduces stored vectors within the frozen numerical criterion; historical immutable artifact remains unavailable
representationEvidenceGradeSemantics.ALIAS_ONLY: only mutable model alias evidence exists
